validation_boundary: The authoritative ATOM model/schema/validator files and exact SEA v4 protocol were not directly retrievable. This report therefore does not claim execution of those unavailable authoritative files. Structural and sufficiency checks use a strict local contract reconstructed from recent validated project outputs and the retrieved large-source workflow.
extraction_limitations: All atoms are model-extracted and remain needs_review; no human verification status was fabricated.
The observational target-trial emulation does not randomize treatment and cannot eliminate unmeasured confounding.
Supplementary RCT summaries were not promoted to primary-study atoms.
The STROBE checklist and podcast transcript are companion material, not primary outcome evidence.
No protocol-specific numeric SEA score was assigned because the exact governing SEA protocol could not be retrieved.
